purpose: One train/validation-only feasibility study for transition-supervised MambaNVP; never a full model training run.

frozen_inputs.policy: frozen deterministic descending score, candidate ID ascending tie break, policy45

population.selection: within each explicit dataset_id, program_id ascending; first max_per_source programs only

controlled_probes.sequence_encoder: single-layer GRU over ordered frozen pass tokens
controlled_probes.checkpoint_selection: none; evaluate exactly at the frozen final step
controlled_probes.objective: same soft-label candidate cross entropy over K=50 normalized_target

transition_signal_gate.candidate_loss: three-seed mean held-out CE is strictly lower for oracle than BASE
transition_signal_gate.policy_metric: three-seed mean held-out policy45 dataset-macro MeanOverOz is strictly higher for oracle than BASE in at least two of three paired seeds
transition_signal_gate.breadth: oracle policy delta has positive median across explicit validation sources and positive sources outnumber negative sources
transition_signal_gate.on_failure: stop; do not train a transition predictor or full TS-MambaNVP

predictor_if_signal_supported.architecture: initial Autophase conditioning plus token embedding, positional embedding, two residual Mamba blocks (d_model=64), final-token 56-D delta head
predictor_if_signal_supported.normalization: per-feature train delta RMS, clamped at 1e-6
predictor_if_signal_supported.predictability_gate: three-seed learned normalized MSE beats every baseline globally and beats per-pass mean on a strict majority of validation sources
